updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
Release 3.1.7.5

Summary for this release
• The introduction of OpenKneeboard Version 2 now with EFB, AH-64 AI CREW, intercom handling, and runtime reliability.
• Includes many improvements and fixes from previous version and now OKB Help documentation

Added
• Added new OKB Out version 2 overlay controls with cleaner annimations and floating overlay.
• Added Navigraph EFB API integration with expanded EFB charting workflows.
• Added EFB Moving Map mode with faster ownship internal GPS feed, plus JTAC overlays and chart-search support.
• Added AH-64D George Pilot support with expanded recipient handling and keyword coverage.
• Added TX5 intercom support for modules with multiple single-select radios and a separate intercom (e.g., AH-64).
• Added OKB offline manual and EFB pin/focus controls.

Improved
• Hardened OKB Navigraph auth flow and ETA/ATA logic, including EFB recommended speed-cue behavior and fallback handling.
• Added EFB landing-assist Moving Map auto zoom and NAVLOG behavior, added EFB module-connection gating and charting reliability.
• Improved AH-64 AI CREW command flow with long-press enhancements, startup/shutdown aliases, and route/mask handling updates.
• Improved cockpit-state sync for CMWS, exterior lights, APU, and related command toggles to reduce desync.
• Refactored AH-64/George logic into extension packages for cleaner AI CREW separation and maintainability.

Fixed
• Fixed battle-position alias handling and several missing/incorrect George command aliases.
• Fixed OKB tab case-sensitivity and tab-click unit refresh issues that could show no data until voice activity.
• Fixed AI CREW recipient migration/display issues (crew → george) to keep logs and OKB AI CREW tab aligned.
• Fixed suppress-carrier-ATC auto-flow behavior behind manual calls.
